title: Possible a Azure DevOps personal access token literal assigned to AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT in source
description: The file contains a Azure DevOps personal access token literal assigned to AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT. A committed token grants its scopes to anyone who can read the repository or artifact until it is revoked. Shape-only: the match does not prove the token is live.
remediation: Revoke the token in the provider console, audit the actions it performed, and issue a minimally scoped replacement that is injected at run time.
limitation: Shape-only: a 20+ character token-shaped literal assigned to a token-named key. It cannot prove the token is valid or unrevoked.
